::: {#exm-reparameterization}

#### Autograd through the draw

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
mu = torch.tensor(1.0, requires_grad=True)
sigma = torch.tensor(0.5, requires_grad=True)
eps = torch.randn((), generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(0))
z = mu + sigma * eps
z.backward()
print(eps.item(), mu.grad.item(), sigma.grad.item())
```

With the [reparameterization trick](#def-reparameterization),
autograd finds $\partial z / \partial \mu = `r sprintf("%.0f", py$mu$grad$item())`$
and $\partial z / \partial \sigma = `r sprintf("%.3f", py$sigma$grad$item())`$,
the value of $\noise$ drawn.

:::
